objective: Bring the Rough Quartz to Canaga Earthcaller in the Valley of Trials.

description: Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Canaga Earthcaller as proof of our meeting. He will craft a totem for you, and this pebble will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast many others.
Be patient, <name>. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.
progress: I wish to be the first to welcome you fully to the first of four paths that will forever lead you in your destiny.
If you have the stone the earth gave to you, I will give you the totem it promised.
If not, then be gone with you until you have found your way.
completion: The totem I will craft for you is more than a symbol of your status among <class>--it has abilities beyond that. One use of the totem is as a focus for spells. Those spells are tied to the earth, and as you earn greater and greater wisdom, more of the earth's abilities will be made accessible to you.
The trainers will know when you are ready for greater knowledge.
But for now, take this earth totem, and a scroll to teach you your first ability.
